speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight lines, and they thanked me as if rightness were a fault. The company is no better.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Kemp was at his slippers. He has not been shown the book. I will not show it to him to mend a morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Friday is the Knave. The king is a different paper, and it stays at the hedge.
